violation_type.title: Additional Requirements For Outdoor Activity Space Not Connected To Operation - Written Plan for Supervision (26 TAC §744.2961(2))
violation_type.short_title: Additional Requirements For Outdoor Activity Space Not Connected To Operation - Written Plan for Supervision
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation did not have a written plan explaining how they plan to supervise the children while playing and traveling to the outdoor activity space that is not connected to the operation.
